title: Our Community
subtitle: 考点：社区场所 / There is / There are
passage: I live in a nice community. There is a big park near my home. There is a playground in the park. Children play there in the afternoon.
There is a hospital next to the park. There are two shops and a library on the street. I like my community very much.
vocab: community 社区 · playground 操场 · park 公园 · hospital 医院 · shop 商店 · library 图书馆

questions.why: a big park near my home
There is a playground in the park.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: Children play in the park in the afternoon.
questions.why: Children play there in the afternoon.

questions.stem: The hospital is next to the library.
questions.why: 医院在公园旁边（next to the park）。
I like my community very much.

sections.title: 三、选词填空（每词限用一次）

questions.stem: There is a big ____ near my home.
There is a ____ in the park.
There is a ____ next to the park.
